step1_figure.circuit_type: Two-stage CMOS operational amplifier with Miller compensation and zero-nulling resistor
step1_figure.description: Figure 24.8 shows the complete schematic of the two-stage CMOS op-amp with NMOS diff-pair (M1, M2), PMOS mirror load (M3, M4), NMOS cascode tail current source (M6T, M6B), PMOS common-source second stage (M7), NMOS cascode current sink load (M8T, M8B), along with compensation network Cc and Rz, driving load capacitor CL. Figure 24.13 (page 781) specifies the exact compensation component values Cc = 2.4 pF and Rz = 6.5 kΩ.

equation.explanation: Total DC gain is the product of first stage gain (gm1 * R1) and second stage gain (gm2 * R2), where R1 is output resistance at node 1 and R2 is output resistance at node 2.

sky130_expected.calculation: For I_D1 = 10 uA, gm1 ≈ 150 uA/V, ro1 ≈ 1/(lambda*ID) = 1/(0.1*10u) = 1 MOhm. Cascode/diff-amp output resistance R1 ≈ 200 kOhm to 500 kOhm -> Stage 1 gain ≈ 30-75. Second stage gm2 ≈ 150 uA/V, R2 ≈ ro7 || ro_cascode ≈ 200 kOhm -> Stage 2 gain ≈ 30. Total gain ≈ 900 to 2250 (59 dB to 67 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard two-stage CMOS topology on SKY130 1.8V typically yields 55 to 65 dB open-loop gain.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency where open-loop gain magnitude drops to 0 dB (unity gain frequency fun)

equation.explanation: With Miller pole-splitting, unity gain frequency is set by input stage transconductance gm1 and compensation capacitance Cc.
equation.assumptions: Dominant pole approximation with RHP zero eliminated by Rz.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed for 10 MHz unity gain frequency as specified in Eq. (24.10) with Cc = 2.4 pF.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the open-loop op-amp at unity gain frequency

equation.explanation: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the unity-gain frequency fun.
equation.assumptions: Unity feedback beta = 1; zero cancelled by Rz = 1/gm2.

sky130_expected.calculation: With dominant pole well below fun, second pole around 200 MHz, and zero cancelled by Rz = 6.5k, phase at 10 MHz is approx -90°, giving PM = 180 - 90 = 90°.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fig. 24.13 shows PM = 90° with Cc = 2.4 pF and Rz = 6.5 kΩ.

gain_margin.description: Gain margin of the open-loop op-amp where phase reaches -180 degrees

equation.explanation: Amount of gain below unity (0 dB) when loop phase reaches -180 degrees.
equation.assumptions: Phase crosses -180 degrees at high frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Phase reaches -180° well beyond 100 MHz where gain is around -25 dB, yielding GM ≈ 25 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fig. 24.13 indicates approximately 25 dB gain margin.

dominant_pole_frequency.description: Dominant pole frequency f1 caused by Miller multiplication of Cc

equation.explanation: Pole at node 1 shifted down by Miller effect of second stage gain gm2 * R2.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Pole-splitting with Cc = 2.4 pF lowers the dominant pole from ~287 kHz (at 100 fF) to ~10 kHz.

non_dominant_pole_frequency.description: Second non-dominant pole frequency f2 associated with the output node

equation.explanation: High-frequency pole pushed outward by Miller compensation capacitor to node 2.

power_dissipation.description: Total quiescent DC power dissipation of the op-amp

equation.formula: P = VDD * I_total = VDD * (I_M6 + I_M8 + I_bias)
equation.explanation: Sum of currents supplied by VDD multiplied by VDD.
equation.assumptions: Static DC operating point without external resistive load.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail = 20 uA, I_M8 = 10 uA, I_bias ≈ 30 uA -> Total current ≈ 60 uA. P = 1.8 V * 60 uA = 108 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: At 1.8V supply with ~30 uA core current and bias branch, power is ~100 uW.

output_voltage_swing_max.description: Maximum output voltage before M7 leaves saturation

equation.explanation: Limited by the PMOS common-source transistor M7 entering triode region.

sky130_expected.reasoning: PMOS requires at least ~100-150 mV VDS to stay saturated.

output_voltage_swing_min.description: Minimum output voltage before cascode current sink (M8T, M8B) enters triode

equation.explanation: Limited by the two series NMOS transistors of the cascode current sink entering triode.
equation.assumptions: Each NMOS saturated with VDS,sat ≈ 100 mV.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Cascode NMOS current sink requires ~200 mV compliance voltage.

equation.explanation: Differential input voltage required to drive output to mid-supply (VDD/2).
equation.assumptions: Nominal device matching without random variations.

sky130_expected.calculation: With balanced sizing between stage 1 mirror and stage 2 current sourcing, systematic offset is small (< 5 mV).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Proper mirror sizing minimizes systematic offset near zero.

step3_testbench.description: SPICE testbench to measure DC operating point, total power, open-loop AC gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, gain margin, and DC transfer characteristics / output swing / systematic offset.
